independent_sse_url_audit.comparison: original ADDDATE versus SSEDATE in every captured SSE row with a unique official document URL
independent_sse_url_audit.late_definition: original ADDDATE > SSEDATE + 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai
independent_sse_url_audit.result: SSE permits late-added or backfilled rows whose ADDDATE is materially later than their SSEDATE query-membership date

reason.coverage_failure: The bounded capture enumerated SSE rows only where SSEDATE lay between 2017-10-01 and 2021-12-31. Because V29 gates events by ADDDATE-derived available_at, a row with ADDDATE inside a candidate's 120-day decision window may have an SSEDATE before 2017-10-01 and therefore be absent from this capture.
reason.logical_scope: The audit does not assert that a missing severe-risk row exists. It proves that absence cannot be established over the knowledge-time domain from the captured query-membership domain.
reason.why_page_conservation_is_insufficient: Exact pages, hashes, pagination totals, and within-query conservation prove only what each requested SSEDATE interval returned; they do not prove ADDDATE-domain completeness outside those requested intervals.

required_remediation.sse_causal_available_at: max(original ADDDATE, SSEDATE + 1 calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai)
required_remediation.sse_query_membership_coverage: For every SSE symbol in the frozen V28R2 parent-candidate universe, enumerate SSEDATE from the SSE opening date 1990-12-19 through 2021-12-31.
required_remediation.szse_minimum_coverage: publishTime from at least 2017-10-01 through 2021-12-31; date-only or midnight values become available at next calendar day 00:00 Asia/Shanghai
